newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall on poor mill demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall on poor mill demand.

text.p: Cotton prices fell on Wednesday on poor demand from textile and yarn mills, traders said.
"Market sentiment is weak. There's hardly any demand from mills. Business volumes were very low," said a trader.
In Ready delivery, Gujarat Kalyan was quoted 100 rupees lower at 13,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Gujarat Wagad was unchanged at 12,600 rupees per kg.
Punjab saw-ginned was unchanged at 1,520/1,640 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). Bengal-deshi was steady at 860/890 rupees per maund.
